name: Rapel
context: Rapel reservoir dataset from Chile, containing daily measurements of water level, tributary inflow, and precipitation. This reservoir is a key hydroelectric asset in Chile's electricity system, where inflow and precipitation strongly influence water level dynamics.

endo.name: water_level
endo.description: Daily average water level in the Rapel reservoir. This is the primary target variable for forecasting reservoir state and supporting hydroelectric generation planning.

exo.name: tributary_inflow
exo.description: Daily average tributary inflow (Afluente) in m³/s into the Rapel reservoir. This is the main exogenous driver of changes in reservoir water level.

exo.name: precipitation
exo.description: Daily precipitation affecting the Rapel reservoir catchment area. This exogenous variable provides additional predictive power for future inflow and water level changes.
